concerns.text: The plan asserts that the full pipeline (downloading all common dbSNP SNPs, scoring every SNP‑TF pair, and running 100 permutations) will complete in ≤ 6 h on a free‑tier CI runner (2 CPU, 7 GB RAM). Given the scale of dbSNP common variants (several million SNPs) and the number of human TF PWMs (~600), the total number of SNP‑TF pairs approaches billions, which far exceeds the compute and memory budget of the specified environment. Even with batch processing, the I/O, scoring, and permutation loops are unlikely to finish within the claimed runtime, making the approach infeasible under the stated constraints.
